title: ATN's Tribute to 100 Years of Indian Cinema
description: Highlighting the best moments from 100-years of Indian cinema.

title: Thambikku Entha Ooru
description: Balu, a carefree and spoiled rich kid, is sent to a village to learn discipline under the watchful eye of an ex-military man. He butts heads with the fiery Sumathi, but their rivalry soon turns to love. Balu faces both challenges and betrayal.

title: Jee
description: Vasu wishes to contest in the college elections but is forced to withdraw in favor of the local MLA's son. When the MLA's goons bash him up, he decides to fight back.

title: Pattukku Oru Thalaivan
description: Arivu is a drunkard who is trying to forget the woman he loved, Shanthi, after his father died when he asked for her hand in marriage to his son. Shanthi finds his mother to convince her that she actually loves Arivu.
